name: RW06 Main - Claims documents
description: RW06 real-world test: Document claims processing: mail -> split and classify -> extraction -> policy rules -> human review -> ERP draft (no payout). Runs its six child agents, then cleans up the run's test records and sums up.

variables.name: base
variables.description: Folder of the real-world tests: data, output and the stand-in server.

variables.name: run_id
variables.description: Run id shared by a main agent and its children; made here when empty.

variables.name: standin
variables.description: Address of the local QA stand-in server (127.0.0.1 only).

variables.name: watch
variables.description: Show message boxes and pause between records so a person can follow the run.

variables.name: pause_seconds
variables.description: Pause after each record when watch is on.

variables.name: fault_profile
variables.description: none, or resilience: the stand-ins inject the five failures of runbook step 09.

variables.name: concurrency
variables.description: 1 runs the children one after another (to watch); 2 or 3 runs children whose inputs are ready together.

variables.name: status
variables.description: success when every child agent finished.
